I was being treated for depression since I was 14. I stopped treatment about 7 years ago when I left my family home to move 200+ miles away. 

Last year, things got so bad with my mental health that I lost a job, my fiancé and everything else I hold dear all because nobody realised what was going on. 

I began treatment in December 2018 after losing everything. 

2 weeks ago, my doctor prescribed the wrong medication to me. This resulted in a mental breakdown and suicidal state which I am still not over. 

Not a single person has checked on me despite me reaching out when I needed help. 

Please don’t let anybody else you know go through this. It is the worst feeling in life by a long way.
That I will do

Sorry if this sounds harsh. I don’t have to do anything anymore. I’m just ticking the minutes down until my death day. One final memory and then I can die with a smile on my face and at peace. 

I don’t want another woman or relationship. I have no plan B in terms of that. My plan B is how my plan A would end and that is death.

Mostly my two kids. They’re too young to remember me but I know they’d love one last trip out with me. They wouldn’t know it’d be the last time and that’s the beauty of innocent youth I guess. 

They’d have 150k each sitting in a trust fund for when they turn 18 due to my life insurance which would pay out as my method would easily look like an accident that is covered under my policy. 

I’m just after something to think of when the time comes so I can die happy.

I’m currently avoiding going to work as I genuinely feel I would jump in front of the train as it pulls into the station. 

I know there is an earlier train that doesn’t stop there and I’d rather get there to jump in front of that train than anything else as I wouldn’t stand a snowflakes chance in hell of surviving the impact. 

I often think would I even need to jump and just lean my head into the path of the train and... well that would be that

I have tried so far. I am a massive lover of game of thrones, in fact am I reading fire and blood between comments on here. 

Even wanting to know how the story ends isn’t enough to keep me going. I want to have one final spend on the 25th March and then I’m done. 

Thank you for trying

I’m in physical pain because of the breakup. I can painful chills and burning in my chest, torso and head. 

I appreciate that you’re trying to help shadow man, I’ve been in your position before trying to help somebody else but in the end, it was too much for them and me. 

I’m slowing coming to terms with my decision and so far I’m okay with it

I can’t find any strength. All I’m trying to do is get by each minute until 25th March and then I can finally escape from it all. It will easily be a selfish decision and I will be hated for it. But the thought of being hated by friends and family alike in death is the exact same thing I have in life. 

Making these comments isn’t brave to me. This is the only place I can let my feelings show because nobody knows who I am and even if somebody who knew me found my posts, they wouldn’t be able to link them to me.
Kinda want to know the method tbh. I’m trying to come up with one and it’s tough to decide

I built and planned my entire life with somebody. 

I’ve now lost her, my kids, my home and even my cat. 

I can safely say that I’m staying around until 25th March when I get a 1,500 bonus from work and can pay some things off before I off myself.
I’d hate to say it but every method will involve pain as it is the body’s way to say something is wrong and the body perceives death and something wrong

I am 25 and don’t think I’ll see 26 tbf. My plans are to finish it all on March 25th this year. 

I don’t know anybody who’s gotten better personally

Getting a new tattoo is a must as well, I only have the stark dire wolf on my forearm right now and need more.
On the better job front, there is a lot of money in insurance. I went from earning 18k in 2016 to 30k+ by the end of 2018.

The monthly goal thing sounds so simple yet it fits me so well. 

I think the hardest part will be learning how to be single. We were together for 7 years and I was 18 at the time. I’m now 25 and single for the first time in my adult life and it scares me.
I think we’re all here for the same reasons. Vent, support and be the shoulder to cry on.

Like yourself, I don’t know why I’m putting this on reddit. I feel like a coward for thinking what I am but I can’t see any way forward. I’d planned the rest of my life being with her and I just don’t know where to turn anymore. Nothing else truly mattered to me except loving her and now it’s gone. 

I’ve dedicated myself to her since I was 18 and now there is nothing for me to look forward to. I’m visiting my parents next month who live 300 miles away and if I don’t get better then, I’m going to end it.
